chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight Places.
chapter_note: Exceptionally clean substrate chapter. A systematic eight-fold enumeration mapping the living fire (one of the five light elements) to eight cosmic locations, with the fire identified as 'consideration' (one of the five intellectual faculties). Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — land of light, the Father, the First Man's armour, the ship of the day, the light-giver of the night, the Living Spirit's body, the new earth, eschatological revelation. No editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation material detected. The only non-substrate material is the opening dialogue frame formula. Heavy lacunae in several paragraphs but the teaching structure is intact.

paragraphs.core_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame formula 'Once again the apostle speaks:' — pure attribution with no cosmological content.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Standard dialogue frame attribution wrapping the thesis statement that defines the eight-fold enumeration. The thesis itself is substrate — it establishes the teaching structure.

paragraphs.core_text: The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it ... ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and ba]sis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration: fire mapped to the light land. Identified as 'foundation and basis' of the great earth, and as 'consideration' — the faculty correspondence linking fire to the intellectual quality. Both sides of the mapping are cosmic. The term 'consideration' connects to the five intellectual faculties system (Ch.56).

paragraphs.core_text: The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration: fire mapped to the Father, linked again to 'consideration.' Describes emanation process — powers coming from the Father, fire revealed with/through them. Classic emanation hierarchy vocabulary. Both sides cosmic.

paragraphs.core_text: The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o ... ... ] armour. Again, it is this fire [ ... ... ] on the body of the Perfect Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration: fire mapped to the First Man's armour/body. Heavy lacunae but the cosmic mapping is clear — fire swathed on the body of the Perfect Man. Body-cosmos correspondence pattern.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth enumeration: fire mapped to the outer wall / ship of the day (sun). Cosmic geography — 'ship of the day' is a standard cosmic vessel designation. Process vocabulary: 'purified from all the light powers.'

paragraphs.core_text: [The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [ ... ] within the water.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth enumeration: fire mapped to the light-giver of the night (moon) and its association with water. Cosmic geography. Lacuna may have contained further description.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sixth enumeration: fire mapped to the Living Spirit's body. Describes cosmic process: swathing, the summons and obedience (cosmic call-and-response events), descending, and stripping before the Porter (cosmic being). All entities and processes are within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [ ... ] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Seventh enumeration: fire mapped to the new earth, again identified as 'consideration' (the faculty correspondence). 'First foundation' and 'first course' describe cosmic architecture. 'Crown for the entire earth' is structural-cosmic. Heavy lacunae but substrate throughout. The recurrence of 'consideration' confirms the fire-faculty mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [ ... ... ] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [ ... ] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eighth enumeration: fire mapped to eschatological cosmic events — revelation, fear, war, terror as cosmic signs, and the two light ships (sun and moon). This is cosmic eschatology, not contemporary application. 'Fear and war' and 'terror' are cosmological qualities of fire's eschatological manifestation, not editorial moralizing.

paragraphs.core_text: This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Closing summary recapitulating the thesis. Standard enumeration closure formula. Purely cosmological — no exhortation, no application, no editorial extension.
